title: Chat: Hide empty confirmation dropdowns
body:
## Summary

Confirmation buttons could render as split buttons whenever `moreActions` was present, even when the list was empty or contained only separators. This exposed a dropdown affordance with no actionable choices.

This change renders a split button only when at least one real additional action is available. It applies the behavior consistently to both confirmation widget implementations and adds regression coverage for empty, separator-only, and actionable dropdown lists.

Fixes #337412
